contract.phase_scope: All12 frozen phases with their original answer cutoffs, full-day10% alerts and four-model/five-seed identities. Only three distinct development months enter descriptive consistency screens.
contract.history_population: All raw approvals before cutoff with non-null purchase<=approval. Never filter final status or final legacy eligibility to construct the as-of approval cohort. Static seller/customer attributes retain the original export-time assumptions.
contract.approval_cohort: For each query t and known own key, independent historical approval in [t-W,t), W90 for seller/route/joint and W30 for route30. Same-ID query/history approvals must agree. Unknown keys are not pooled; counters missing, known empty history counters zero.
contract.asof_partition: approved=completed+pending+invalid_delivery. Valid completed has approval<=delivery<t. Already observed delivery<approval is invalid. Pending means no delivery observed strictly before t; delivery==t is pending for history and separately counted. No new reminder eligibility is evaluated.
contract.promise_partition: Valid promise is non-null and calendar promise day>=approval day. Deadline=promise day+1day. Pending=active+overdue+invalid_promise; overdue when deadline<=t; invalid promise splits missing/negative, never treated as on-time. Promise-day sums use valid integer calendar offsets only.
contract.carrier: pending_no_carrier_event counts no carrier timestamp<t, regardless of eventual final status; absence of a recorded event is not proof of physical non-shipment.
contract.clocks: Future delivery/carrier at or after2018-05-01 censored before calculations. Each query still masks every event>=t. Event time only proxies availability; ingestion/revision/cancellation clocks are absent.
contract.legacy_metadata: Frozen70844 query identities mark the prior final-delivered eligible population, solely for retrospective composition and source reconstruction. Legacy membership never defines the new as-of denominator or either primary audit ratio.
contract.delivery_bridge: Original eligible completed delivery-window count=legacy completed from the same approval window+legacy completed with older approvals. The two windows are not directly interchangeable denominators.
contract.age_composition: Both completed and pending use elapsed t-approval, not eventual delivery duration. Fixed [0,7),[7,14),[14,30),[30,60),[60,90] days; route30 last bin includes30 and omits older bins. Right-censored pending duration is not filled with future outcomes.
contract.promise_composition: Report completed/pending valid promise counts and sums, separately from approval-age bins. Matching fixes current query conditions, not every historical order own promise/age.
contract.ratio_denominator: Same status-free approval cohort. Unknown key or zero approved gives missing ratio, never zero. No prior smoothing. Per-query means and occurrence-pooled ratios are distinct summaries.

comparison_bases.route90: original route30 AND route90 mature support bins

contract.comparison_conditions: Full state route x promise condition x Monday00 approval week x candidate-specific unchanged mature support bin(s). Three fixed schemes: original promise bins; exact integer promise days; exact days plus query weekday Mon0..Sun6. Never coarsen after sparse results.
contract.cohorts: Same-identity all20 common misses versus all same-stratum known on-time queries (primary), or other known delayed (secondary). Five focus groups ALL/R/A/RA/SP->SC retain every seed own four-model common misses. Unknown query labels are not read.
contract.coverage: finite overlap>=1 miss/1 control; cohort adequate>=3 finite misses/5 finite controls; supported additionally every required mature support>=20. All common misses remain denominator; missing/no control/low cohort/low local support are disjoint reasons.
contract.aggregation: Stratum mean differences and within-stratum risk ordering use finite miss-n weights; controls standardized to the same weights. Equal-stratum sensitivity retained. Risk sign+1 for both audit ratios; ties abs<=1e-12 count0.5. Pairs/overlapping histories/seeds are not independent replications.
contract.context_profiles: All16 fixed groups retain status-free history counters, age/promise composition and raw denominator totals across query cohorts; route30 is descriptive context. Histories overlap between queries; occurrence totals are not distinct orders. Distinct history coverage reported separately by basis.
contract.public_cell_detail: 2018-02/2018-02/evaluation, five focus groups, six basis-ratios at all three schemes; compact aggregate cells, no identities or individual score/rank vectors.
contract.consistency_screen: Exploratory only: each of all three schemes supported common n>=20 and weeks>=3, mean and ordering-minus0.5 same nonzero direction, all five own-seed summaries align, same direction in>=2 distinct development months. Positive/inverse both reported; no automatic training selection.
contract.redundancy: Label-free exact-duplicate and Spearman comparisons against original101 numeric white list; existing pending counts and overdue numerators separately reconstructed. A coverage gap or nonduplicate ratio does not establish new information or incremental model benefit.
prohibitions: No model deserialization/replay/fit, new scores/alerts, quota, ensemble, seed/model/default choice or original holdout rescore.
No use of future final status, future delivery duration or query label to construct prospective audit ratios.
No causal attribution, significance/CI from reused pairs/windows or choosing matching thresholds after observing results.
contract.privacy: Only aggregate profiles and stratum context published. Raw history, audit cache, row identities and independent execution proofs stay Git ignored.

pre_publication_format_correction.change: Public support_by_basis metadata tuples normalized to JSON lists; strict roundtrip regression added. No counts, matching, thresholds, weights or analysis rules changed. Initial run stopped by code-hash protection before publishing any report or inspecting new outcome-conditional results.

representation_quality.scope: Query-history occurrences overlap; distinct rows are counted separately per basis.

existing_counter_reconstruction.negative_promise_overdue_difference: Original pending overdue includes negative promise days. New valid-promise overdue excludes them; adding separately retained negative-promise pending exactly reconstructs the original.

label_free_redundancy.interpretation: Label-free duplicate/association description only. Existing pending/overdue numerators are already in101; a different denominator, absent exact duplicate or lower correlation does not establish incremental prediction benefit.

contract.condition_scope: Conditions fix current query route/promise/approval week/support; they do not equate historical orders' own promise or elapsed ages.
contract.ratios: Unsmoothed pending/approved and overdue-pending/approved within one approval cohort. Unknown keys and approved=0 are missing; query means and pooled occurrence ratios are distinct.
contract.weighting: Finite common-miss n weights differences and order probabilities; control means standardized to those weights. Equal-stratum sensitivity is also retained.
contract.clock: Support bins retain original delivery-event counts, not new approval-cohort counts. Week Monday00:00, weekday Mon0..Sun6; strict event clocks and history state defined by upstream audit.
contract.interpretation: Audit associations only; +1 orientation is a prespecified hypothesis, not model risk. Overlapping windows, groups, reused controls and seeds are not independent samples. No training or automatic selection.

representation_consistency_screen.interpretation: Exploratory representation-association consistency only. A flag does not validate a new signal, significance, causality, incremental prediction, deployment or feature selection.

limitations: Status-free unfinished history is an unobserved-delivery proxy, not verified physical backlog: cancellation/ingestion/revision clocks are unavailable.
Legacy final-delivered eligibility is retrospective metadata only. Current query matching does not make every historical promise or approval age comparable.
Same-approval-cohort completion/pending contrasts are descriptive and structurally selected; pending elapsed age is a lower bound on duration, not an observed final duration.
Query-history occurrences, reused controls, five seeds and repeated historical months are dependent; no significance, causal or incremental prediction claims.
The three prespecified matching schemes retain different query subsets/weights. Sparse weekday coverage cannot be repaired by changing conditions after inspection.
A representation discrepancy or passing descriptive consistency screen is not a new-feature training result. Existing101 already contains pending/overdue history and deterministic ratios.
